name: Diverse Dueling Blades (Combat)
body:
You are able to use your spectacular techniques with other blades.

Prerequisite(s): Weapons of the duelist.

Benefit(s): You may select a weapon from the heavy blades weapon group. You may consider this weapon as a finesse blade for purposes of any class abilities of the swordlord guardian, the Diverse Swordlord Techniques feat from this book, and the Weapon Finesse feat. This does not allow the wielder to use the weapons with two hands for swordlord guardian class abilities unless otherwise allowed.

Special: This feat may be taken multiple times. Each time the feat is taken, a new weapon is chosen.
